liked_by_similar_users.rule: Emit when the recommended item has a positive selected Item-CF neighbor contribution from the user's positive training history.

popular_in_training.rule: Emit when the item has at least one positive training event and the selected popularity weight is positive.

extension_model_match.rule: Disabled because validation selected a zero LightGCN weight.

similar_to_recent.rule: Not emitted offline because the strongest Item-CF contributor is not necessarily the most recent history item.

cold_start.rule: Use the frozen popularity ranking when a user is unknown or has no eligible positive training history.
